content: If the value of dynamicArraySizeProfile of a multi- dimensional variable size array equals VSA_FULLY_FLEXIBLE , the values of all length fields of the nested serialized variable size arrays that belong to this multi-dimensional variable size arrays shall be calculated based on the value of the size indicator of the corresponding variable size array that is contained in the AUTOSAR data type.
